cues.en: Hey, everybody.
cues.zh: 各位好。

cues.en: Welcome to your Gtlm course.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到 ZTM 課程。

cues.en: Now, as part of being a Gtlm student, you get to have a couple of nice freebies, a little bonus,
cues.zh: 身為 ZTM 學生，能取得一些免費資源、小獎勵，

cues.en: a little extras that all the students that are part of Gtlm get.
cues.zh: 以及所有 ZTM 學生都能使用的額外內容。

cues.en: Let me show you some of the extra things you get as part of this course.
cues.zh: 來看看課程還提供哪些東西。

cues.en: First off, we already talked about it, but we have a pretty big community of tech enthusiasts learners, so we have a ton of coding challenges.
cues.zh: 首先，前面提過，我們有很大的科技愛好者與學習者社群，也有許多程式挑戰。

cues.en: If you go to our website and go to the community tab, we have coding challenges that you can practice some skills with.
cues.zh: 到網站的 Community 分頁，可以透過程式挑戰練習技能。

cues.en: We have open source projects that are open to anybody that anybody can participate.
cues.zh: 也有任何人都能參與的開源專案。

cues.en: That's part of Gtlm.
cues.zh: 這是 ZTM 的一部分。

cues.en: We have our discourse server, we have campus events, which is like a live virtual classroom that you get to meet other students and talk to them.
cues.zh: 有 Discord 伺服器、Campus 活動，像線上的即時教室，可以認識並與其他學生交流。

cues.en: And we also have events like Advent of Code or Octoberfest throughout the year.
cues.zh: 全年也有 Advent of Code、Hacktoberfest 等活動。

cues.en: We also have cheat sheets.
cues.zh: 另外還有速查表。

cues.en: Now these are all free.
cues.zh: 這些全都免費。

cues.en: None of this requires any sign up.
cues.zh: 不需要註冊。

cues.en: You can just open up a cheat sheet that is related to your course that you want to check out.
cues.zh: 可以直接開啟與課程相關、想查看的速查表。

cues.en: Let's say we want to check out the JavaScript one.
cues.zh: 例如想看 JavaScript。

cues.en: Well, you can actually go through the cheat sheet here and follow along with the course and maybe take notes along the way.
cues.zh: 可以一邊上課一邊參考速查表，也能做筆記。

cues.en: These cheat sheets we add every month a new cheat sheet.
cues.zh: 我們每個月會新增一份速查表。

cues.en: So you can just keep an eye on this tab and check out different cheat sheets based on your interests.
cues.zh: 可以留意這個分頁，依興趣查看不同速查表。

cues.en: We also have our blog where we post 2 to 3 blog posts a week.
cues.zh: 還有部落格，每週發表 2 到 3 篇文章。

cues.en: So quite a lot.
cues.zh: 數量不少。

cues.en: And we have different topics for beginners, for people that are already working in the industry, different instructor posts.
cues.zh: 主題涵蓋初學者、已在業界工作的人，以及不同講師的文章。

cues.en: We also have posts about how to get hired, so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 也有求職相關文章等等。

cues.en: So you can check out our blog and we have different tabs here.
cues.zh: 可以查看部落格，這裡有不同分頁。

cues.en: Obviously beginner start here, advance your career.
cues.zh: 像 Beginner Start Here、Advance Your Career。

cues.en: But the most important one is right here.
cues.zh: 但最重要的是這裡。

cues.en: We have monthly industry newsletters, so every month myself and other Gtlm instructors write a recap of what happened that month in the industry.
cues.zh: 每月產業電子報，由我和其他 ZTM 講師整理當月業界動態。

cues.en: You know how you're always overwhelmed with blog posts, what to read, how to stay up to date with the industry.
cues.zh: 是不是常覺得文章太多，不知道讀什麼、如何跟上產業？

cues.en: Well, we try to make it easy for you so that you don't have to read 100 blog posts, watch 100 YouTube videos every month just to stay up to date.
cues.zh: 我們希望讓這件事更容易，不用每月讀 100 篇文章、看 100 支 YouTube 影片才能跟上。

cues.en: Instead, we recap what happened in the industry.
cues.zh: 改由我們整理業界動態。

cues.en: So we have a web developer monthly that recaps what happened in the industry that month.
cues.zh: 有 Web Developer Monthly，回顧當月的產業消息。

cues.en: What are the best resources to read?
cues.zh: 有哪些最值得閱讀的資源？

cues.en: What is the big takeaway all digested into one blog post like this one?
cues.zh: 有哪些重點？全部整理成這樣的一篇文章。

cues.en: But we also have one for Python, one for machine learning and a blockchain developer.
cues.zh: 也有 Python、機器學習與區塊鏈開發者版本。

cues.en: Now we're going to add a few more throughout the year, but these should cover a lot of the interests that students have.
cues.zh: 今年還會增加幾種，但目前已涵蓋學生的許多興趣。

cues.en: Now, finally, you can also check out our career paths.
cues.zh: 最後，也可以查看 Career Paths。

cues.en: So this if you're looking for a certain career, we'll give you advice on what path to follow, when to apply for jobs, what sort of skill levels are required for each of these careers.
cues.zh: 如果有特定職涯目標，會建議學習路徑、何時求職，以及各職涯需要什麼程度的技能。

cues.en: So again, this website you can use for free doesn't require any sign up and you can find different sort of information based on your needs.
cues.zh: 這個網站免費，不用註冊，可以依需求找到不同資訊。

cues.en: Now, two last things.
cues.zh: 最後還有兩件事。

cues.en: One is that we have a LinkedIn group for all our students, so this is great.
cues.zh: 第一，有所有學生的 LinkedIn 群組。

cues.en: If you have a LinkedIn profile and you want to endorse each other's skills, get advice, career advice from people.
cues.zh: 如果有 LinkedIn 個人檔案，想互相認可技能，或向別人請教職涯建議，很適合。

cues.en: So there's lots of things happening in our group and people are always sharing job openings, tips and advice on career Day and also endorsing each other's skill.
cues.zh: 群組很活躍，大家常分享職缺、職涯訣竅與建議，也會互相認可技能。

cues.en: So if you want to boost your LinkedIn profile, this is a great place to start.
cues.zh: 想強化 LinkedIn 個人檔案，這是很好的起點。

cues.en: And then finally, we also have a YouTube channel that we recently started, and we're posting about
cues.zh: 最後，最近也開了 YouTube 頻道，每週發布大約，

cues.en: 3 to 4 videos a week, different topics that are free that you can kind of check out.
cues.zh: 3 到 4 支免費影片，涵蓋不同主題，可以看看。

cues.en: And as you see, we already have a ton here.
cues.zh: 這裡已經有很多。

cues.en: We're going to have a lot more coming up throughout the year.
cues.zh: 今年還會增加更多。

cues.en: But you can check out our YouTube Channel zero two Mastery as well.
cues.zh: 也可以查看 Zero To Mastery 的 YouTube 頻道。

cues.en: All of these you get for free as being part of the team student.
cues.zh: 身為 ZTM 學生，這些都免費提供。

cues.en: So enjoy.
cues.zh: 好好享用。

cues.en: Good luck.
cues.zh: 祝你順利。

cues.en: Use these resources to your advantage and welcome to.
cues.zh: 善用這些資源，也歡迎加入。
